subject.title: fix(llm-slug-generator): use truncateUtf16Safe for session content truncation

question: Should maintainers consolidate this slug-generator UTF-16 fix on the sibling branch with regression coverage, require this branch to add equivalent proof and tests, or explicitly override the proof gate for this narrow internal prompt-boundary fix?
rationale: The source bug and helper-based fix are clear, but this external PR lacks real behavior proof and regression coverage while a sibling PR already carries the same runtime fix plus a test but is also proof-blocked.

options.title: Consolidate on the covered fix
options.body: Prefer the sibling branch once it has real proof or a maintainer override, then close duplicate branches rather than landing multiple copies of the same fix.

options.title: Require this branch to catch up
options.body: Keep this PR open only if the contributor adds redacted real prompt-path proof and focused regression coverage equivalent to the sibling branch.

options.title: Override proof and land one branch
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept source, helper-contract, and CI evidence for one narrow internal truncation fix despite missing contributor real behavior proof.

recommendation.title: Consolidate on the covered fix
recommendation.body: Prefer the sibling branch once it has real proof or a maintainer override, then close duplicate branches rather than landing multiple copies of the same fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is the clearest Hooks routing candidate and has recent adjacent UTF-16-safe truncation history.
